title: Design System: Asset Audit by Aharoll

severity-medium.displayName: Medium Ochre (also the action color on dark)

title.purpose: Product names, panel and sheet titles, FAQ questions.

code.purpose: Labels on objects: severity, blade number, scores, shot names. Never sentences.

shadows.name: blade
shadows.purpose: A blade resting in the fan.

motion.name: ease-fan
motion.purpose: Blades opening: 0.9s, staggered by 6ms per degree from center.

motion.name: fan-close
motion.purpose: Collapse to the stack before re-fanning with scan results.

components.name: Severity chip
components.description: The only place saturated color lives.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Install on Shopify and other primary actions.

narrative.overview: The catalog is a printer's formula guide: one blade per product, photos as chips, missing shots as hatched empties, severity painted on the tip. The black cover blade carries the action.
keyCharacteristics: Severity is the only saturated color

rules.name: Color means severity
rules.body: Every saturated color maps to a severity; everything else is gray, white or black.

rules.name: One family, many widths
rules.body: Archivo at width 125 for display, 118 for codes, 100 for reading.

rules.name: Lift along the radius
rules.body: Blades move outward along their own axis; nothing scales.

dos: Do keep the scan on the cover blade
Do label every third-party number with its source
donts: Don't use glow, glass or gradient decoration
Don't invent reviews or customer logos
